quality.note: Numerical fidelity against the supplied FP32 reference and baseline; not labeled tagging accuracy.

limitations: No extra GPU trace was captured.
Standalone memory is process footprint, not host-app-plus-worker memory. Paired models share immutable weights and stay resident; paired footprint cannot be compared.
Initial standalone sweep used original compact indexing. Adjacent compact trials used the shared-offset LUT prototype.
Remote device was dedicated to one benchmark at a time, but macOS background processes including media services remained active.
M4 starts required normal thermal state, GPU <=55 C, maximum sampled P/E scaled use <=40%. M3 adjacent starts required normal thermal state, GPU <=60 C and scaled CPU use <=40%.
Selected source hashes describe final checkpoint; remote measured executable preceded explicit baseline pinning, which leaves its existing default control unchanged.
Numerical fidelity on this corpus is not labeled tagging accuracy or evidence of a universal performance ceiling.
